viewer_head_dedicated_aria: Open in own window: {{engine}} (opens in a new tab)
viewer_focus_hint: Click to turn focus ON (mouse control)
viewer_focus_aria: Turn focus ON for the 3D viewer (mouse control)
viewer_seq_pymol_failed: PyMOL could not select this range.
viewer_seq_pymol_sync_note: The sequence and PyMOL's selection follow each other: one range of one chain shows in both.
viewer_seq_pymol_multi: PyMOL's selection spans several ranges, so the sequence shows none of it.
viewer_seq_pymol_chains: PyMOL's selection spans several chains, so the sequence shows none of it.
viewer_seq_pymol_other: PyMOL's selection is outside this structure, so the sequence shows none of it.
viewer_seq_pymol_large: PyMOL's selection is too large to read, so the sequence shows none of it.
viewer_seq_pymol_hetero: PyMOL's selection includes atoms outside the sequence (a ligand, water), so the sequence shows none of it.
viewer_seq_pymol_selections: Several selections are shown in PyMOL, so the sequence shows none of them.
viewer_eraser_paused_hint: Drag across a line to remove the whole line. Rotation is paused while the eraser is active.
viewer_recovered: The 3D view stopped drawing and was restarted at the same camera.
viewer_history_note: What each viewer window showed, saved automatically when you moved to another window. Only you see it. Entries are kept for 30 days, at most 20 per viewer.
viewer_history_load_failed: The history could not be read.
viewer_history_restore_failed: This entry could not be restored. It may have been deleted, or PyMOL is not ready yet.
viewer_history_delete_failed: This entry could not be deleted.
viewer_history_adopted: {{engine}}: took over the work saved in another window at {{time}}.
viewer_history_newer: {{engine}}: another window saved newer work at {{time}}.
viewer_pymol_unsaved: PyMOL in the 3D panel has work that is not saved. If you leave this page, it is lost. Save it first with "Save session" in the PyMOL bar.
viewer_surface_opaque_hint: Draw the molecular surface fully opaque instead of translucent
viewer_surface_opaque_suppressed: Translucent while a ligand or docking pose is shown
viewer_3dmol_notice: 3D view: 3Dmol.js — Copyright (c) 2014, University of Pittsburgh and contributors. Used under the BSD-3-Clause license.
viewer_mates_hint: Show, in grey, the molecules packed against this one in the crystal: its space-group symmetry copies, including those across the unit-cell boundary
viewer_mates_cutoff_hint: Show only molecules with at least one atom this close
viewer_mates_none: No molecule is in contact at this distance ({{spaceGroup}})
viewer_mates_unavailable_no_cell: No unit cell in this entry (e.g. a predicted model)
viewer_mates_unavailable_placeholder_cel: Not a crystal structure (e.g. electron microscopy or NMR)
viewer_mates_unavailable_invalid_cell: The unit cell is invalid (flat or impossible angles)
viewer_mates_unavailable_no_space_group: No space group in this entry
viewer_mates_unavailable_unknown_space_g: The space group could not be interpreted
viewer_mates_unavailable_unreadable: The structure file could not be read
viewer_mates_unsupported: Not supported by the server yet (backend update pending)
viewer_mates_too_heavy: Could not finish in time at this distance (try a shorter one)
viewer_mates_too_heavy_min: Could not finish in time, even at the shortest distance
viewer_mates_too_large: This molecule alone has more atoms ({{atoms}}) than the viewer can copy, so no neighbor is shown
viewer_mates_not_found: This structure no longer exists (it may have been deleted)
viewer_mates_unavailable_crowded: The coordinates put more atoms in one spot than any real molecule has (the file looks broken)
viewer_mates_failed: Could not load the crystal neighbors
viewer_surface_type_vdw_hint: VDW = van der Waals surface — the atoms' own spheres merged together. No solvent probe is involved.
viewer_surface_type_ms_hint: MS = Molecular Surface — the surface a water-sized probe cannot roll into. Gaps too narrow for water are filled in, so it is smoother than VDW without being thinner.
viewer_surface_type_sas_hint: SAS = Solvent-Accessible Surface — traced by the probe's CENTRE, so it sits about one water radius outside the molecule.
viewer_surface_type_ses_hint: SES stands for Solvent-Excluded Surface, but 3Dmol's SES does not draw one: it keeps only the probe-eroded solid, so every atom is drawn thinner than it really is.
viewer_surface_type_sas_caveat: SAS lies one water radius outside the molecule — do not judge pocket width or contacts against it.
viewer_surface_type_ses_caveat: SES draws atoms thinner than they are — do not judge pocket width or contacts against it.
viewer_navigate_hint: The mouse rotates and zooms the view
viewer_tool_note_pen: Pen in use: rotate and zoom are paused
viewer_tool_note_eraser: Eraser in use: rotate and zoom are paused
viewer_eraser_empty: There is no line to erase
viewer_tool_returned: No line is left, so the mouse rotates and zooms again
viewer_ink_not_in_ray: The ray-traced image has another shape than the view, so the freehand lines are not on it.
viewer_ink_left_out: The freehand lines could not be drawn on the saved image; it was saved without them.
viewer_kept_button_hint: PyMOL kept running in the background. Open the list.
viewer_kept_intro: PyMOL stays running for 15 minutes after you leave a structure, so coming back shows it as you left it. Up to {{max}} are kept, the oldest let go first. Only a PyMOL whose work is already in the session history is kept, so releasing one loses nothing.
viewer_pen_hint: Draw freehand over the view. Rotation is paused while the pen is active.
viewer_ink_stale: The view moved, so the drawing no longer lines up
viewer_ink_stale_capture: Note: the drawing is at its pre-view-change position
viewer_depth_fog_hint: Fade distant parts into the background colour to bring out depth (a fade to the background, not a blur)
viewer_depth_slab_hint: Clip the front and back away and show only a slice of the chosen thickness
viewer_depth_cap_hint: Close the cut face so the molecule reads as solid rather than hollow (as UCSF Chimera does). The cut face appears once Front cut is moved in
viewer_depth_cap_color_custom_hint: Pick any colour for the cut face — for matching a figure's palette
viewer_depth_cap_opacity_hint: Give the cut face an opacity of its own. While off it follows the surface's, so this is the only way to draw a solid surface with a see-through cut, or the reverse
viewer_depth_ortho_hint_follow: Draw without perspective, so a cross-section is not skewed. Turns on by itself while electron density is shown (the view Coot draws). A click against that setting holds its projection whether density is shown or not; clicking back to the automatic side makes it automatic again
viewer_depth_ortho_hint_no_density: Draw without perspective, so a cross-section is not skewed
viewer_depth_reset_hint: Return depth cue, cross-section and projection to their defaults
viewer_rev_overlay: Computed on revision {{rev}}'s coordinates, overlaid on the current revision {{current}}.
viewer_rev_overlay_no_current: Computed on revision {{rev}}'s coordinates, overlaid on the current coordinates.
viewer_rev_overlay_unknown: Computed on coordinates of a revision that cannot be identified, overlaid on the current revision {{current}}.
